links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated runs of the same amyloidosis questions
links.effect: GPT-3.5 scored reliably on more than 83.3% of responses; GPT-4 produced above 98.2% consistent answers.
links.quote: When assessing reproducibility, GPT-3.5 scored reliably on more than 83.3% of responses, while GPT-4 produced above 98.2% consistent answers.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy and reproducibility of ChatGPT (GPT-3.5 and GPT-4) on amyloidosis questions without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
